headline: First Half 2025: Visitor Numbers Rise at A-Share Scenic Area Companies, but Profits Under Pressure as Lower Per-Capita Spending and High Costs Become Main Causes
summary: Revenue at 21 A-share scenic area companies fell about 3.8% on average in the first half of 2025. Lower per-capita spending and high costs pressured profits, and only 8 firms grew both revenue and profit.
why: Scenic area operators are tourism companies listed in mainland China, so their results signal consumer spending and travel demand in the Chinese economy.
